data.name: Tanvika
data.long_meaning: Tanu (dazzling, radiant) + Vika (goddess). Derived from the Sanskrit language, Tanvika is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl in Hindu tradition. This name is associated with the goddesses of love, beauty, and fertility. It symbolizes the inner light and divine grace that every girl embodies.
